description: Create ARCHITECTURE.md documenting: (1) Inter-daemon topology with all daemons, their ports, and dependencies; (2) write_service contract at :8772 — write path /query path /execute path with examples; (3) Signal invariant — the exact shape {signal_type, confidence, evidence_blob} that every signal producer must write to mcp_signal_scores or mcp_signal_enrichments; (4) Heartbeat contract — every daemon writes to service_health at least every 60s, stale > 2h is dead; (5) No HTTP between peer daemons rule with correct pattern diagram.
